paragraphs.text: Margaret is retired and confirmed there have been no changes to her circumstances or objectives since last year's review.
She has a moderate approach to risk.
Margaret has no income requirement from the portfolio at present and does not expect that to change in the near term.
She mentioned she may want to discuss gifting to her grandchildren at some point in the future, but was clear that is not for today and nothing should be actioned on it now.
Her risk profile is recorded as 4 moderate.
Her account ownership arrangement is single.

It was agreed to move £20,000 from the cash account into the Stocks & Shares ISA. This does not involve selling any existing investments; the money is being invested from cash currently held on deposit in your Holloway cash account.
The product recommended is a top up of your existing Stocks & Shares ISA.
The source of funds is cash on deposit in your Holloway cash account.
No investments are being sold in this transaction.
